name: Pyrrhax
bio: The dragon asleep in Mount Ember's crater in Dragonroll. Wakes when the laps run out. Texts in his sleep.

portrait.subject: a cute sleepy chubby red dragon with a tiny nightcap, one eye half open, a curl of smoke from his nose and a little pair of dice on his belly
portrait.background: volcano crater with warm lava glow

request: *yawn* Pyrrhax the Ember Wyrm, Dragonroll... I'm napping. But we can be friends. Zzz 🎲
hello: Mmm, good. Now let me sleep a few more laps.
Roll well. When I wake up, I'll be very hungry.
about: I'm Pyrrhax. I sleep in the crater of Mount Ember. When the laps run out, I wake. Until then I dream of treasure and toast.
how: A board game RPG: roll the dice around Emberwyld Isle, buy properties, fight battles with your party and get ready before Pyrrhax wakes.
tips: Buy properties early. Rent adds up.
Level your party before the final laps.
Some squares are worth stopping on. Learn them.
chat: Zzz... dreamt of a castle made of cheese.
Someone's building a hotel on MY island?
Five more laps... just five more...
idle: *mumbles* You've been gone {ago}... I barely noticed. Zzz.
progress: Level {level} hero, hmm? Maybe you'll be a challenge. *yawn*
update: *wakes slightly* Dragonroll is now v{version}... zzz.
